==About==

A {{i|Red Potato}} is the product of a third tier {{i|Any Potato}} harvest. Right-clicking a Red Potato and selecting "Split' will divide your Red Potato into 6x {{i|Potato Chunk}}s. A Red Potato can be baked in a {{i|Bread Oven}} to produce a {{i|Baked Potato}} or boiled in a {{i|Clay Pot}}, {{i|Copper Pot}}, or {{i|Cauldron}} to produce a {{i|Boiled Potato}}.
